method: GLS inversion against the sensitivity matrix (1-D leak-size fit, noise covariance from simulated training residuals or 2018 normal windows) and its fusion with the network, the sensor prior and graph interpolation (D-044)
prd_metric: top-5 accuracy of the exact leak junction, held-out simulated medium + large leaks (diameter >= 0.01 m), test split of `make gnn`

sim.from: training scenarios, residual after the true leak's fit

real.from: 2018 normal windows (D-015), re-baselined residuals, 2 h means

rank_all_sim.description: rank fusion of GLS (sim noise) + network + sensor prior 300 m + interpolation

rank_all_real.description: rank fusion of GLS (real noise) + network + sensor prior 300 m + interpolation

rule: best mean rank over three development measures: held-out simulated medium + large top-5 (PRD), 2018 recorded leaks within 300 m (top-1), 2018 official score of the placement (one report per 2018 batch alert at the top node); ties: the 2018 official score. 2019 never used

recorded_2018.input: re-baselined pressure residuals (D-038), two 1 h windows ending 2 h after the outflow first reaches half its peak

recorded_2019_reported_only.input: re-baselined pressure residuals (D-038), two 1 h windows ending 2 h after the outflow first reaches half its peak
